The '''Alliance Officer's Candidate School''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] tactical school for Ground Officers. The officer candidate received training for a period of six months, taking courses in tactics, communications, psychology, and strategy as well as physical training. The history of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with particular attention to the battles of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was studied.
